parsed.why: Low-risk tier; explicit gender-identity discrimination ban with remedies, X-marker licences, city sanctuary shielding travellers; no facility ban or trans-specific criminal law. National border/passport exposure caps it.

Criminal drag/impersonation ban upheld, birth-sex bathroom and prison placement, indecent-exposure statute, closed ID documents, care bans, no GI hate-crime coverage. Tier-1 state-imposed universal exposures.

Do-Not-Travel tier: birth-sex facility mandate covering airports with criminal fines and private bounty suits, invalidated licences, sex defined by birth. Airport exposure reaches travellers directly.

Moderate-risk tier; no adult facility ban or adult care ban, document changes available, sodomy repealed. Hostile measures are youth/school and regulatory, plus GI gaps in hate-crime and nondiscrimination law.

Facility ban extended to public colleges/universities, prison treatment freeze, no hate-crime statute, unrepealed sodomy, escalating tier below national level; school-setting restriction rather than general adult facilities.
